sourceScope.requested: Technology of the Human Sphere (standalone sourcebook)
sourceScope.availability: NOT PROVIDED in connected Google Drive source folder or project attachments
sourceScope.actualData: 585 existing equipment records from V74, with their existing provenance and descriptions preserved

features: Read-only technology catalogue for existing gear with fast search and category browsing
Medical equipment index includes surgical facilities, field kits and diagnostic devices
Infogear/quantronic gear grouped separately from augmentations and modifications
Safe add-to-first-free-slot without overwriting gear or enabling reference-only vehicles/facilities
Per-equipped-slot and per-item quality, modifications, notes and explicit GM review
Changing gear clears its stale annotations; editing an approved record resets GM review
Autosave/browser JSON/XML round-trip through technologyGearJson scalar
Print row short annotation without changing underlying source equipment mechanics
No expansion of weapon/equipment slots; original custom 2d20 rules unchanged
Embedded index/app source parity and no changes to data.js
deliberateLimits: NOT a full sourcebook import: original Technology sourcebook equipment and exact quality/modification prices/mechanics not present
User-entered quality/modification notes grant NO automatic skill, damage, Armour, Focus, rarity or cost bonus
Display categories are UI indexing convenience based on existing item types and names, not official source categories
Print rows may truncate long notes under existing layout; full notes preserved in saves
Synthetic test harness; not full real-browser interactive testing

tests.name: Gear HTML compiled and V75 marker
Technology UI is nonprint and in sheet
Slot and item names prevent cross-item metadata leak
Quality and mods included in print rows

Editing approved modification resets prior GM approval
GM can explicitly reapprove edited gear
Replacing a gear item discards stale quality and mods
